core_obligations: Degree zero (proof lines 2916-2917): the case p = 0 is the corresponding statement about global sections of a colimit of sheaves over a colimit of sites, which the author cites.

Reduce to the vanishing of the colimit (proof lines 2919-2925): embedding the system into a system of injective sheaves as provided by the companion lemma, and arguing as in the proof of the companion colimit result of this chapter, it suffices to show the vanishing of the cohomology of the colimit sheaf in positive degrees.

Cech computation (proof lines 2927-2943): any covering of the colimit site comes from a covering at some stage, and the Cech complex of the colimit sheaf with respect to it is the filtered colimit of the Cech complexes at the stages; those are acyclic in positive degrees, and a filtered colimit of acyclic complexes is acyclic, so the cohomology of the colimit sheaf vanishes on every object.
proof_roadmap: Settle the degree zero case by the corresponding statement on global sections.
Embed the system into injectives and reduce to the vanishing of the cohomology of the colimit sheaf.
Compute the Cech complex of the colimit sheaf as a filtered colimit of acyclic complexes at the stages, and use the acyclicity of filtered colimits of acyclic complexes.
difficulty_reason: The lemma identifies the cohomology of the colimit sheaf over the colimit site with the colimit of the cohomologies at the stages, for every degree (statement lines 2904-2914, whose set-up is fixed by the companion statement delivered as a context span from lines 2854-2875). The proof disposes of degree zero by the corresponding statement on global sections (proof lines 2916-2917), then embeds the system into injective sheaves and reduces to showing the vanishing of the cohomology of the colimit sheaf in positive degrees (proof lines 2919-2925), and finally computes the Cech complex of that sheaf as a filtered colimit of the Cech complexes at the stages, which are acyclic, so that acyclicity of filtered colimits finishes the proof (proof lines 2927-2943). The non-formal content is the identification of the Cech complexes through the stages. The claim is H2: three steps, each written out.
